svg.text: Phase 6 · milestone 3 · Vehicles and schedules: layout options
Dark theme. Your choices: pins per person, in each group; chained rules count from the meter's zero, or the vehicle's In service since date (else Acquired);
catalogue fields copied, then editable; types built on a kind, for new vehicles, optionally naming a template. Where there are options, the first is recommended.
Yours only. Pinned ones come first in their group whatever the sort; among themselves, in the same sort.
A · 📌 ON THE CARD, PIN IN ITS ⋯ MENU (RECOMMENDED)
Pin / Unpin is in the card's ⋯ menu,
and in Arrange mode. Works offline.
B · A PIN BUTTON ON EVERY CARD
Always one tap, but a button on
2 · Chained intervals, and In service since
The requirement dialog's rule row gains a first interval; the vehicle's Setup tab gains an optional date.
years from In service since (12 Jun 2019, est.)
Not done yet and nothing typed under Last done before these records: the first interval counts.
Once done (or that's typed), only the repeating part.
First at 100,000 mi, then every 50,000 mi
First at 3 years, then every 2 years
Not done yet · due at 100,000 mi or 12 Jun 2022
Built, or first registered. For a used vehicle, backdate it.
Empty: the Acquired date, else the day the requirement was added.
+ Add field → From the catalogue. Each is copied into the vehicle's own fields; ones it already has are greyed out.
5 fields: trip distance, time, average speed, fuel economy, fuel used
8 fields: the trip computer's, plus EV distance, EV share, EV time
4 fields: idle time, engine run time, oil life %, DEF level %
Pressure and tread depth for each tire, by axle
A set added again gets " B" on its labels and keys (Trip A, Trip B).
Pressure in your pressure unit; tread in 32nds of an inch or mm.
4 · Vehicle types (Manage → Vehicle types, Admin mode)
Laid out like Groups and Templates: the list on the left, the chosen type on the right. Changing a type changes only vehicles added afterwards.
Keeps the car's rules: fuel economy, its meters' kinds, High means Not drivable.
none ticked: it needs no documents
Fields: Trip time; + Tires (2 axles); + Engine and idle
+ Add meter + Add field + From the catalogue
Copied onto each new vehicle, as Apply template does.
Its vehicles keep everything; they show as their kind.
5 · Adding a vehicle, and how a type shows
The kind chooser lists the household's types after the app's kinds.
Picking a type shows what it starts with: no documents, 2 meters,
ON THE CARD AND THE HEADER
No main photo: the type's icon. The Overview's header says
"Track car (a car)". Setup can change a vehicle's type later;
that changes only the label and icon, never its records.
B · TWO STEPS: KIND, THEN "WHICH TYPE?"
Pick Car, then Car or Track car. Fewer chips, one more tap.
